rationale: Fixed direct check for unit-claim-config-store-delivery, executing the premise that exploration already observed. Source reading (configuration.go:44-52, fsm.go:118 as the sole StoreConfiguration call site, fsm.go:127-186 as the batching bypass, testing_batch.go:13-33) predicts StoreConfiguration is unreachable for an FSM implementing BatchingFSM, while BatchingFSM.ApplyBatch documents that LogConfiguration entries are sent to batching FSMs. The clean-copy exploration of this exact scenario (operation bcaa06c272bf4890bff151ccfd995409, check a55fcacbd6224839904320183312312e) reported committed config index 4, applybatch_config_indices [1,4] and store_configuration_calls 0 with entry_delivered_to_fsm true. This product now fixes that scenario as a formal artifact: a prerequisite that the FSM implements both interfaces and that a configuration entry committed, an applicability condition that the entry was actually delivered to the FSM, and an assertion that ConfigurationStore.StoreConfiguration was invoked. The harness is unchanged from the explored bytes, so the executed premise is preserved; the obligation, oracle, identity (op_id) and scope are not weakened. The oracle is not tests_passed: the assertion is evaluated from the emitted delivery event, and the test is expected to exit 0 whether or not StoreConfiguration is called.
